Critical issues include 31 confirmed broken internal documentation links and weak freshness visibility at 20.84% coverage. API reference coverage stands at 75.37% across 154 detected API pages. Example code reliability estimates at 90.6%, indicating generally healthy code samples. 5 links remain unverified due to authentication or rate-limiting barriers.
